Yes. The dog's first pictures on Tuesday (20 Oct) were taken at 11:28, and people were in the lab from then on. It took no pictures earlier that morning, so I can't say anything about before 11:28.

**What the pictures show, 11:28–11:47** (102 pictures, people in 54 of them, never more than 2 in one picture). I opened six of them. I think there were at least four different people, told apart by clothes:

- **White top and glasses**, with a beige jacket over the chair. Sitting at a desk, seen from near desk_khang at 11:28 (t1792520886809).
- **Dark t-shirt and glasses**, at a desk facing the camera, in front of the door. Seen at 11:36 and 11:46 (t1792521383653, t1792521964868).
- **Light grey t-shirt**, at a desk further back on the right in those same two pictures. Also seen from near desk_oliver at 11:37 (t1792521424271).
- **Maroon shirt and white trousers**, seen near desk_yuyang at 11:44 (t1792521875598).
- A fifth set of clothes: **dark t-shirt, light grey trousers and grey trainers**, seen near desk_pragya at 11:43 (t1792521838267). Only the legs and body show, so this could be the dark-t-shirt person above. I'm not counting them separately.

Place names like desk_khang are where the dog was standing, not where the person sat.

People were still there after noon: one or two people in pictures from 12:00 to 12:26 (grey t-shirt, plus someone in white).

The dog only looked at the desk areas it walked past, so there may have been more people in other parts of the lab.
